module: Module 5: Partial Fills, Asymmetric Rejections & Slippage
title: Fill Price Averaging Across Multi-Currency Accounts
precondition: Sub-accounts in USD, EUR, GBP; block executes on EURUSD.
expected_result: Identical base execution price assigned; FX currency conversion applies only to realized P&L and margin.
actual_result: Identical VWAP base price assigned to all child tickets; FX conversion applies only to margin and realized P&L.
